Excellent service, well worth the annual cost for a reliable business who can then afford to invest in products, support & service. The Xapo BTC loan product is easy & quick, options are well presented.

I have been with Xapo for a few years and have had very good service from them. Their security is really tight, quite complicated procedures, and if you don't follow these then you won't get in, but I think we all understand how important it is to have such a tight security.
Great experience so far. Best fees to buy and sell BTC, great customer support, and superb security features. Definitely recommend to anyone looking to grow crypto and fiat holdings.

Xapo boasts a wide array of services, especially BTC-backed loans so that I do not have to withdraw my precious BTC. Xapo's app boasts a beautiful interface that is also very functional and replete with access to all the services I need.

The perfect bank from bitcoiners for bitcoiners. App is getting better almost every week, the support team is super fast, helpful and professional. Absolutely worth every penny. Definitely one of my best decisions to become a member!

Xapo Bank is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a secure and reliable way to manage both USD and Bitcoin in one place. The platform is easy to use, highly professional, and clearly built with security as a top priority. Their Bitcoin custody approach really stands out and gives great peace of mind.

Xapo is renowned for its safe custody solutions, and through Xapo Bank, members can easily access global Tradfi financial services. Having a dedicated relationship manager makes the experience seamless.
Great experience and very professional approach, strong security.
